checkDestinationTargets(bytes).details: External ONLY so `receiveAndExecute` can self-call it and contain `abi.decode` panics on a      malformed `sigData` — mirrors StargateAdapterV2's `handleCompose` self-call (:239-247).      Returns a code rather than reverting so the caller can distinguish "malformed blob"      (caught, treated as MATCH_OK) from "explicit mismatch" (funds delivered, execution skipped).MUST only be called by this contract; it is NOT a general-purpose public API despite      being view-only. Guard mirrors StargateAdapterV2.handleCompose (:268).

params.sigData: The raw SignatureData blob appended by the source hook

returns.code: MATCH_OK when the proof matches or no proof exists for this chain

params.token: The token to claim (USDC, or the token minted on the non-USDC escrow path)

params.messageTransmitter_: CCTP V2 MessageTransmitter on this chain
params.tokenMessenger_: CCTP V2 TokenMessenger on this chain (must already have a local minter wired)
params.usdc_: USDC token on this chain (the token CCTP mints for a Superform intent)

decodeHookPayload(bytes).details: External ONLY so `receiveAndExecute` can self-call it and contain `abi.decode` panics on a      malformed tail. MUST only be called by this contract.

receiveAndExecute(bytes,bytes).details: PERMISSIONLESS — see contract-level NatSpec for why this is safe. The adapter must have been      set as the message's `mintRecipient` and `destinationCaller` on the source chain.A message that mints a registered non-USDC CCTP token is consumed and escrowed to the attested      burner instead (see `_receiveNonUsdc`); no delivery and no execution happen on that path.

params.message: The raw CCTP V2 message bytes (contains the hookData payload as its tail)

MESSAGE_TRANSMITTER().notice: The CCTP V2 MessageTransmitter used to receive + verify messages

SUPER_DESTINATION_EXECUTOR().notice: The SuperDestinationExecutor for processing bridged executions

SUPER_DESTINATION_VALIDATOR().notice: The destination validator wired into the executor, cached at construction

TOKEN_MESSENGER().notice: The CCTP V2 TokenMessenger on this chain; its `localMinter()` owns the remote→local token registry

USDC().notice: The USDC token minted by CCTP on this chain

checkDestinationTargets(bytes).notice: Report whether the DstProof for this chain targets this deployment's executor/validator.

claimFailedTransfer(address,uint256).notice: Claim a previously escrowed balance. Only the recipient can claim its own.

failedTransfers(address,address).notice: Claimable escrow balances (failed, undeliverable or surplus credits): account => token => amount

receiveAndExecute(bytes,bytes).notice: Receives a CCTP V2 message, mints the bridged USDC, forwards it to the intent account,         and best-effort executes the signed destination intent.
